wLine.derivation: Alphabetical run 9 (AMODIMETHICONE) to 37 (TRIDECETH-6): 29 consecutive ascending entries (C12-13 PARETH-23 / C12-13 PARETH-3 differ only in digits and count as in order). It does not contain the earliest cleansing surfactant (SODIUM COCOYL ISETHIONATE@2), so it is a tail; its second entry BENZOIC ACID@10 is a candidate (class d, and also class b). No candidate precedes it. (i) SODIUM COCOYL ISETHIONATE@2 before it; (ii) entries of the same run are ignored and nothing between the run end 37 and the cap 38 -> plausible. W-line 10.

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic SODIUM COCOYL ISETHIONATE@2 and prominent amphoteric/glucoside co-surfactants are present (COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE@8, COCO-BETAINE@16, DECYL GLUCOSIDE@17). Counter-signal: four mild anionics occupy positions 2-5 ahead of the first amphoteric (@8), and positions 16-17 lie inside the alphabetical run, so the buffering share is uncertain; confidence moderate, neighbor moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: high: C2 is met - early (prominent, E3 point 38) silicone AMODIMETHICONE@9 (plus DIVINYLDIMETHICONE/DIMETHICONE COPOLYMER@18), cationic polymers POLYQUATERNIUM-10@25 and POLYQUATERNIUM-7@26, pearlizing route GLYCOL DISTEARATE@7 and humectants GLYCERIN@6 / PANTHENOL@21; CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE@14 adds a cationic conditioner. Counter-signal: everything from position 9 on is an alphabetized block (run 9-37), so the cationic and second silicone routes are probably sub-1 %; confidence moderate, neighbor moderate.

weightPotential.rationale: high via the convergence route: three plausibly persistent deposition families converge - amino-silicone AMODIMETHICONE@9 plus DIVINYLDIMETHICONE/DIMETHICONE COPOLYMER@18, cationic polymers POLYQUATERNIUM-10@25 / POLYQUATERNIUM-7@26 and the cationic conditioner CETRIMONIUM CHLORIDE@14 - in a mild C6 chassis whose reset is weak. No lipid leg is used: the only payload lipids (HYDROGENATED COCONUT ACID@19, APRICOT KERNEL OIL@30) lie after the W-line BENZOIC ACID@10 and are non-material, so W-RICH does not hold. Confidence moderate, neighbor moderate: all routes but amodimethicone sit in the alphabetized sub-1 % zone.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Positions 9-37 are alphabetized (W-LINE run), so the cationic polymers, cetrimonium and the second silicone are likely low-dose; the payload lipids are non-material (after the W-line); the four mild anionics could give more reset than "weak".
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Amino-silicone, a silicone elastomer copolymer, two cationic polymers and a quat are designed to deposit and persist even at low dose (6.4/W-LINE rationale), and a mild isethionate/sulfosuccinate/sulfoacetate/sarcosinate chassis does not offset them.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would require the reset to offset the deposition or the deposition to be light; neither is shown by the formula - the late (alphabetized) listing argues for lower amounts but cannot bound them, and a lighter call on doubt is the recommending direction (P0).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Amounts inside the alphabetized block are unknown; the band rests on non-lipid families whose dose cannot be read from order.

focusPrimary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only, claims hidden): general. No claim direction is visible in the blind pass, so no specialist focus has a claim-plus-formula case yet (7.2 "unsupported/generic claims"). Formula care-direction verdict recorded for reconciliation: nonspecific. Formula-led route that could matter: recognized dandruff active PIROCTONE OLAMINE@24 (with SALICYLIC ACID@31).

careDirection.limitation: Generic silicone/cationic conditioning; no protein or damage-care cluster and only two humectants. A recognized anti-dandruff active (PIROCTONE OLAMINE@24) makes scalp_active possible if a dandruff claim appears.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Claims hidden; the provisional value can change only through 3.2 reconciliation.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction: null (blind). Formula compatible: n/a until a claim names a job. Decision: provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered and kept: no exact-product positioning is visible in the blind pass (Section 8 condition 1 cannot be met).
focusSecondary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): []. Secondary focus requires distinct exact-product positioning, hidden in the blind pass.

usageRole.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): regular, the default (Section 9). Every non-default trigger needs a moderate/high-graded claim or direction (CL-SRC), hidden in the blind pass. treatment becomes possible because dandruffSupport is supported (needs a qualifying E2 dandruff claim, U3); alternating impossible (not strong).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): not_targeted, because SC1 positioning (an E2 sensitive/dry claim unit graded moderate/high) cannot be seen in the blind pass. Formula half (CSA) recorded for reconciliation: CSA would pass - prominent comfort route PANTHENOL@21 and humectant GLYCERIN@6 (prominent by E3). Counter-signals: declared PARFUM@38; SALICYLIC ACID@31; no cooling agent.

dandruffSupport.rationale: supported: the complete INCI contains PIROCTONE OLAMINE@24, a recognized anti-dandruff active (Section 11 table; DS1 for selenium sulfide). Formula-only property, final in the blind pass; whether a dandruff target is projected depends on the claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).
